chairman.title: Message from the Chairman
chairman.body: I believe that reputation is not built by promises, but by consistency in every action, every product, and every commitment fulfilled each day. We honor the values built over the years, while continuously innovating to take Hai Huong into a stronger chapter of growth.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.body: Founded in 2010, Hai Huong Seafood (HHFISH) is one of the leading enterprises in pangasius farming, processing, and export in the Mekong Delta. With a closed value chain from farms to processing plants, HHFISH secures its raw materials, controls quality, and meets international market standards.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: Hai Huong aims to build a sustainable seafood enterprise that continuously innovates to strengthen production capacity, complete the value chain, and take the Hai Huong brand further into international markets. We are committed to delivering high-quality products that meet global standards, while creating lasting value for customers, partners, employees, and communities.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: In the coming period, Hai Huong will focus on investing in technology, enhancing production capacity, improving management systems, developing high-quality human resources, and expanding export markets. We remain steadfast in delivering safe, high-quality seafood that meets international standards, while building a sustainable, transparent enterprise that is responsible to the community.

items.description: Growing the business hand in hand with people, environmental protection, and community value.

quality.title: Quality
quality.body: Quality is the foundation of everything Hai Huong does. We put quality standards first and tightly control every stage so that each product reaching customers meets the highest requirements for safety, consistency, and excellence.

team.title: The Strength of Our People
team.body: We believe a united, responsible team with a shared purpose is the foundation for Hai Huong to keep innovating, raising quality, and reaching further in international markets.
team.body2: With a spirit of collaboration and shared growth, Hai Huong is committed to building a professional workplace where every individual can develop their potential, contribute value, and help create a sustainable future for the company.
